In the present appeals also lands are acquired for self
same project, albeit, the notifications under Section 4 were
issued on the different dates.

In First Appeal No.1852 of 2023,
40 R. was acquired from Gut No.125/1, situated at Khadgaon,
Taluka Jamner, District Jalgaon.

The notification under Section
4 of the Act was issued on 24.12.1998.

Slao awarded rate for
the dry lands for a particular group ranging from Rs.25875/- to
Rs.43700/- per Hector.

It was enhanced in LAR.No.1357 of
2005 to Rs.1,80,000/- per Hector.

4. In First Appeal 1858 of 2024, 5 H. 73 R. of land from
Gut No.183 was acquired from Khadgaon, Taluka Jamner.

The
notification under Section 4 was issued on 09.10.1997.

The
self-same rates as recorded in above appeal was awarded and
enhanced.
5. In both appeals award was passed on 20.11.2000.

In
view of the pronouncement of the Division Bench, there is no
difficulty in granting rate of Rs.2,00,000/- per Hector to the
appellants.

The appeals are squarely covered by the judgment
of Division Bench.

Hence, the following order :
 3 12-Fa.1852-23 +1.odt
 Order
(i) First Appeals are allowed partly.

(iii) Save and except above enhancement, the remaining award passed by the Reference Court in LAR.No.1357 of 2005 and LAR.No.1884 of 2005 shall stand confirmed.
(iv) Appellants shall not be entitled to the interest and statutory benefits for the delayed period.
